name: video_id
description: Video whose results panel was read. Primary key. Foreign key to videos.video_id; 1:1 with videos. Also the natural key for this table's replace-semantics writes.

name: bounty_type
description: Tournament bounty format, derived from whether the results panel carries a Bounty column: 'none' | 'progressive'. Scalar rather than a field inside the blob because Phase 3 queries it to select its extraction prompt. Freezeout ('static') bounty is not modelled — no such event has been observed on this channel. NOT enforced as an enum by BigQuery — validation lives in application code.

name: currency_symbol
description: Currency symbol printed on the results panel (e.g. '$'). Every payout and bounty amount in tournament_results_state is denominated in this currency.

name: frame_timestamp_seconds
description: Offset from start of source video, in whole seconds, of the frame the panel was read from. Which rung of the frame fallback ladder succeeded.

name: frame_gcs_path
description: Full gs://... URI to the frame the results panel was read from. Deterministic ({video_id}/results.jpg), so a re-run overwrites rather than orphaning; the ladder rung is deliberately not in the path, since frame_timestamp_seconds records it. Uploaded before this row is written, so a live row's path always resolves. Retained as the manual spot-check evidence for bounty_type, which gates prompt selection for every hand in the video.

name: tournament_results_state
description: The results panel as read. Structure: {panel: {panel_visible: bool, has_bounty_column: bool, currency_symbol: string, rows: [{rank: int, payout: number|null, payout_marked: bool, bounty: number|null}]}}. Payout and bounty amounts are floats and live here rather than in columns because bq_param_type has no FLOAT64 branch; BigQuery parses this column server-side. payout_marked records a printed asterisk verbatim — its meaning is unknown and nothing in the pipeline interprets it. The upstream videos row has no JSON blob, so unlike other stage tables there is nothing nested here.

name: detected_at
description: Timestamp when this tournament results row was written. Auto-populated on insert via DEFAULT.
